title: Courier Pickup Authorization Form
subtitle: Courier Pickup: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Courier Pickup Authorization Form controls parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff by tying each Courier Pickup custody, document, or movement decision to the pickup customer / shipper, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The courier dispatch coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Courier Pickup Authorization Form at pickup address, secure collection point, vehicle, and destination route. Check applicable Courier Pickup requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the pickup customer / shipper approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff scope.

sections.title: Decision context and authorization record
sections.guidance: For Courier Pickup, identify responsible parties, pickup address, secure collection point, vehicle, and destination route, and the linked parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff source.

fields.label: Piece, label, tracking, and seal identifiers
Origin, destination, service level, and pickup window

sections.title: Decision evidence, conditions, and limits
sections.guidance: Capture Courier Pickup facts for parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Courier Pickup conditions; have courier dispatch coordinator assign the next Courier Pickup owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Pickup authority or secure access unavailable
Piece and packaging photograph when needed
blocks.guidance: Pause Courier Pickup when content, identity, authority, security, or service-level exception remains unresolved. Retain the available Courier Pickup proof and route unresolved parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff scope to courier dispatch coordinator.
